level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Power-sum minimum under a reciprocal-sum constraint
units.statement: For k≥1 and positive a,b,c with ab+bc+ca=abc/k, the reciprocal sum is 1/k. AM–GM gives abc≥27k³ and a+b+c≥9k. Since every variable exceeds k≥1, f(x)=x^(x−1) is increasing and convex on this range. Jensen gives f(a)+f(b)+f(c)≥3f((a+b+c)/3)≥3(3k)^(3k−1). Thus a^a bc+b^b ca+c^c ab=abc(f(a)+f(b)+f(c))≥3(3k)^(3k+2), attained at a=b=c=3k.
steps: Convert the constraint to a sum of reciprocals
Bound abc and a+b+c using AM–GM
Apply Jensen to x^(x−1) and check equality
